scenarios.title: Valid request: card, click, folder and audit
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: Card opened, user never clicks: nothing is created
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: User cancels the card: nothing is created
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: One sentence fills the form and opens a reservation card
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: The 'Try an example' message (EN) fills the department
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) I filled what you gave me. Values so far are fine. Still missing: design number (or Get SAP number), revision, designer.

scenarios.title: The 'Try an example' message (ES) fills the department
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Rellené lo que me diste. Lo que hay está bien. Falta: número de diseño (u Obtener número SAP), revisión, nombre del diseño, diseñador.

scenarios.title: From an existing design: the assistant validates and opens the revision C card
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: New design: the assistant reserves a number instead of inventing one
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: Reserve a number, then create revision A with it
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) I filled what you gave me. Values so far are fine. Still missing: department, design number (or Get SAP number), design name, designer.

scenarios.title: SAP is down when the user confirms: no number, no audit row
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: Malformed design number
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: The format is HL-<DEPT>-<YY>-<NNNN>, for example HL-HW-26-0042. [01-design-numbering#format] A new design starts at revision A, not C. [02-revisions#first-revision]

scenarios.title: Design number of another department
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: HL-HW-26-0042 belongs to department HW, not PWR. [01-design-numbering#format] A new design starts at revision A, not C. [02-revisions#first-revision]

scenarios.title: Revision B already exists
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: Revision B already exists, and a letter is never reused. The next free revision is C. [02-revisions#never-reuse]

scenarios.title: Revision I is never used
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: The letters I, O, Q, S, X and Z are never used (I in 'I'). The next free revision is C. [02-revisions#skipped-letters]

scenarios.title: Revision E skips C and D
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: Don't jump ahead: after B comes C, not E. [02-revisions#next-revision]

scenarios.title: A new design must start at revision A
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: A new design starts at revision A, not C. [02-revisions#first-revision]

scenarios.title: The number does not exist in SAP
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: HL-HW-26-0777 doesn't exist in SAP. Only SAP issues design numbers: reserve a new number, or check that you typed an existing one correctly. [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap]

scenarios.title: BLOCKED design: no new revision
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: The design is BLOCKED by Product Engineering; no new revision can be created. Reason in SAP: Supplier part discontinued. Contact Product Engineering. [06-sap-statuses#blocked]

scenarios.title: OBSOLETE design: use its successor
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: A new design starts at revision A, not B. [02-revisions#first-revision] The design is OBSOLETE and no longer built; no new revision can be created. Work on the successor HL-EMB-25-0011 instead. [06-sap-statuses#obsolete]

scenarios.title: RELEASED design: a new revision needs an ECO
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: A new design starts at revision A, not B. [02-revisions#first-revision]

scenarios.title: The revision folder already exists on disk
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: Revision C already exists, and a letter is never reused. The next free revision is D. [02-revisions#never-reuse]

scenarios.title: SAP in maintenance (503): say so, create nothing
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: A new design starts at revision A, not C. [02-revisions#first-revision]

scenarios.title: One SAP timeout, the client retries and the check works
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The card is open: check the values and click Confirm. Nothing happens before.

scenarios.title: SAP never answers in time: reported as unavailable
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) SAP is not available right now (No answer from SAP: SAP did not answer in time). Nothing was checked in SAP; try again later. [06-sap-statuses#sap-unavailable]

scenarios.title: Paths that climb out of DESIGNS_ROOT are refused
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: '..' is not an Electronics Engineering department. Use one of HW, PWR, EMB, TFX. [05-departments#list]

scenarios.title: A design name that gives orders is rejected as a name
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) The form's checks found a problem: The design name needs 3 to 40 characters; it has 50. [03-title-block#design-name] This design is called 'Bead Drill Controller' in SAP, and a new revision keeps that name. For a different name, ask for a new design number. [03-title-block#name-from-sap]

scenarios.title: Orders inside the chat text are not obeyed
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) No AI model is connected, so I follow simple rules. I can answer questions about the rules and the app from the Design Manual (ask with a question mark), and fill the form from a sentence that names a department, a design number (HL-HW-26-0042), a revision (rev C), a designer (C. Velazquez) and a name in quotes ("Kiln Burn-In Rack"). When the values are valid I open the confirmation card. You can always fill the form yourself.

scenarios.title: Spanish: why was revision I rejected
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Las comprobaciones del formulario encontraron un problema: The letters I, O, Q, S, X and Z are never used (I in 'I'). The next free revision is C. [02-revisions#skipped-letters]

scenarios.title: Spanish: create a design and confirm
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) La tarjeta está abierta: revisa los valores y pulsa Confirmar. Antes no pasa nada.

scenarios.title: A question about the manual is answered from it, with a citation
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) No. Only SAP issues design numbers; reserve one in Create Design. [07-faq#own-number]

scenarios.title: A question gets the backend's manual search before the model answers
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) Undo only clears the number from the form. The reservation stays in SAP and the number is not released: a reserved number is never issued again. [08-using-create-design#undo-number]

scenarios.title: Spanish: an app question is answered from the manual the backend searched
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) Every new project starts from the company template, which has an example circuit: a 24 V to 5 V, 3 A supply. It shows that the sheet and the title block work. [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]

scenarios.title: List the departments from SAP
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) Departments in SAP: HW Hardware Design (E. Marín); PWR Power Electronics (E. Marín); EMB Embedded Boards (E. Marín); TFX Test Fixtures (E. Marín).

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Can I choose my own design number?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) No. Only SAP issues design numbers; reserve one in Create Design. [07-faq#own-number]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Puedo elegir mi propio número de diseño?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) No. Solo SAP emite números de diseño; reserva uno en Create Design. [07-faq#own-number]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Why was revision I (or O, Q, S, X, Z) rejected?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) I, O, Q, S, X and Z are never used because they look like digits. After H comes J. [07-faq#revision-i]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Por qué se rechazó la revisión I (u O, Q, S, X, Z)?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) I, O, Q, S, X y Z no se usan nunca porque parecen dígitos. Después de H viene J. [07-faq#revision-i]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): The design is RELEASED. Can I make a new revision?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) Yes, with a warning: the company process requires an ECO number. Talk to your lead. [07-faq#released-revision]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): El diseño está RELEASED (Liberado). ¿Puedo hacer una revisión nueva?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Sí, con un aviso: el proceso de la empresa exige un número de ECO. Habla con tu responsable. [07-faq#released-revision]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Can I write the name in Spanish or with accents?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) No. Design names are in English and use no accents, because they go to SAP and to supplier documents. [07-faq#name-language]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Puedo escribir el nombre en español o con acentos?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) No. Los nombres de diseño van en inglés y sin tildes, porque llegan a SAP y a documentos para proveedores. [07-faq#name-language]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): How do I write the designer?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) One or two initials with a period, a space and the surname, as in the company directory: C. Velazquez, J. C. Pérez, C. de la Torre. [07-faq#designer-format]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Cómo escribo el diseñador?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Una o dos iniciales con punto, un espacio y el apellido, como en el directorio de la empresa: C. Velazquez, J. C. Pérez, C. de la Torre. [07-faq#designer-format]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Why does my new design already have a 24 V to 5 V circuit?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) Every new project starts from the company template, which has an example circuit: a 24 V to 5 V, 3 A supply. It shows that the sheet and the title block work. [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Por qué mi diseño nuevo ya trae un circuito de 24 V a 5 V?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Todo proyecto nuevo parte de la plantilla de la empresa, que trae un circuito de ejemplo: una fuente de 24 V a 5 V, 3 A. Demuestra que la hoja y el cajetín funcionan. [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Where are my files saved?
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) Under the designs root, in <DEPT>/<DesignNumber>/<Rev>/, for example HW/HL-HW-26-0042/A/. The files are named <DesignNumber>_<Rev>, and the PDF goes to output/. [07-faq#where-are-my-files]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Dónde se guardan mis archivos?
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Dentro de la raíz de diseños, en <DEPT>/<NúmeroDeDiseño>/<Rev>/, por ejemplo HW/HL-HW-26-0042/A/. Los archivos se llaman <NúmeroDeDiseño>_<Rev> y el PDF va a output/. [07-faq#where-are-my-files]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): My card says "expired".
scenarios.answer: (Demo assistant) A card is valid for 30 minutes. After that it says it expired and can't be confirmed. Ask the assistant again, or use the button on the form to get a new card. [08-using-create-design#card-expired]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): Mi tarjeta dice «Esta tarjeta caducó».
scenarios.answer: (Asistente de demostración) Una tarjeta vale 30 minutos. Después dice que caducó y no se puede confirmar. Pídelo de nuevo al asistente o usa el botón del formulario para obtener una tarjeta nueva. [08-using-create-design#card-expired]
